## Description

Provide a clear description of the change, problem solved, or feature added.

## Type of Change

- [ ] ?? Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ? New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] ? Performance optimization
- [ ] ?? Refactoring / Dead code cleanup
- [ ] ?? Documentation update
- [ ] ?? Security / Hardening patch

## Verification & Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code passes `bun x tsc --noEmit` with zero errors.
- [ ] Code passes `bun run lint` (non-interactive flat config) with zero errors.
- [ ] Code builds successfully with `bun run build`.
- [ ] No regression in accessibility or reduced-motion behavior (`prefers-reduced-motion`).
- [ ] Tests and manual verification passes recorded.
